### last time {.smaller}

*  cryptographic hashes (secure summaries)
   *  special case for passwords
*  key agreement operation
   *  private value generates key share (~ public key)
   *  our private value + other's key share = shared secret
*  TLS
   *  key agreement, verify key share with signature
   *  verify signature with certificate
   *  use symmetric encryption + MAC after "handshake"
